name: Clam Bait
label: Quest
description: Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village has fished all his life and says the best bait is soft-shelled clam meat, which no fish can resist. He wants ten pieces…
intro: Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village has fished all his life and says the best bait is soft-shelled clam meat, which no fish can resist. He wants ten pieces, to be found around a wrecked ship up the coast to the north.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have the look of a fisherman, adventurer! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?

Up north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't wait to go fishing with some fresh soft-shelled clam meat; did you bring me the 10 pieces of it I need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Perfect mon, this is just what the witch doctor told me to do for my headache. He says, "Mai'Lahii - go fish. It'll make you feel better"
Well, I feel better already, thanks mon!
